t: In addition to amounts otherwise made available in this Act, $500,000,000 is hereby appropriated to the Department of Defense and made available for transfer only to the operation and maintenance, military personnel, and procurement accounts, to improve the intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities of the Department of Defense:  Provided, That the transfer authority provided in this section is in addition to any other transfer authority provided elsewhere in this Act:  Provided further, That not later than 30 days prior to exercising the transfer authority provided in this section, the Secretary of Defense shall submit a report to the congressional defense committees on the proposed uses of these funds:  Provided further, That the funds provided in this section may not be transferred to any program, project, or activity specifically limited or denied by this Act:  Provided further, That amounts made available by this section are designated by the Congress for Overseas Contingency Operations/Global War on Terrorism pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(ii) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985:  Provided further, That the authority to provide funding under this section shall terminate on September 30, 2017.

fable.w: The only procedural step is a report to the congressional defense committees 30 days before the transfer authority is used. That can look like pre-decision consultation, but Congress and its committees are inside the federal government, so nothing crosses the federal boundary. The section otherwise just appropriates funds and sets transfer conditions, with no involvement of states, the public, experts, or other outside parties.
fable.s: the Secretary of Defense shall submit a report to the congressional defense committees on the proposed uses of these funds

opus.w: The only procedural step here is a report from the Secretary of Defense to the congressional defense committees, and both sides of that exchange are inside the federal government. The section is an appropriation with transfer authority. It has no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. The report requirement can look like participation, but it never involves anyone outside the government.
opus.s: not later than 30 days prior to exercising the transfer authority provided in this section, the Secretary of Defense shall submit a report to the congressional defense committees on the proposed uses of these funds
opus.b:
Step 1: The tempting reading is that the Secretary must submit a report to the congressional defense committees before transferring the funds, which looks like a procedural check on the decision. That fails because Congress and its committees are part of the federal government. No outside party is consulted or involved.

qwen_chat.w: The section requires the Secretary of Defense to submit a report to congressional defense committees before exercising transfer authority. According to the definition, Congress and its committees are inside the federal government. Therefore, this reporting requirement is intra-governmental notification, not participation with outside parties.
qwen_chat.s: the Secretary of Defense shall submit a report to the congressional defense committees on the proposed uses of these funds
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the requirement to submit a report to congressional defense committees constitutes "participation" because it involves communication with an external body before a decision (the transfer of funds) is made. However, the definition explicitly states that "Congress, its committees and members... are all INSIDE the federal government." Therefore, reporting to Congress is intra-governmental coordination/notification, not participation with outside parties.
